title: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter
responsibility: Preserve submitted task source as Git objects without moving source HEAD or changing user indexes.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Filesystem path used to resolve the owning repository's Git common directory for comparison with each task worktree. It must identify a Git checkout in the same repository as the worktree.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.checkpoint.input
inputs.description: Identifies the task worktree, its expected source commit, and the paths to include in a checkpoint. The worktree must share the configured root's Git common directory and its current HEAD must equal source; an empty paths array returns source without creating a commit.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.checkpoint
outputs.description: Resolves to the source commit unchanged when paths is empty, or to a new commit ID that records the selected paths with source as its parent. The commit is written with a temporary Git index, leaving the worktree's HEAD and user index unchanged.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown if the worktree's Git common directory differs from the configured root's, or if its current HEAD differs from input.source. Filesystem, Git-command, and commit-identity failures during checkpointing also reject the promise.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.constructor
